# GitHub Copilot Code Review Instructions

## Scope and Ignored Files

- **Auto-generated Database Migrations**: Do not review, comment on, or critique files located in `packages/db/.drizzle/` (including `*.sql` migration files and `.json` schema snapshots). These files are automatically generated by Drizzle Kit (`pnpm --filter @repo/db db:generate`).
- **Database Schema Review Focus**: When reviewing database alterations, focus exclusively on the source TypeScript schema definitions in `packages/db/src/schemas/`, enums in `packages/db/src/constants/`, and relations in `packages/db/src/schemas/relations.ts`.
